title: FMCSA & USDOT Carrier Safety Search Input

dotNumber.title: USDOT Number
dotNumber.description: Official USDOT carrier number (digits only or with prefix, e.g. '22105').

mcNumber.title: MC / MX / FF Docket Number
mcNumber.description: Interstate Motor Carrier docket number (e.g. '202830' or 'MC-202830').

carrierName.title: Carrier Legal or DBA Name
carrierName.description: Search by trucking company legal or DBA name (e.g. 'J B Hunt', 'Knight Transportation').

state.title: US State Code (2 letters)
state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the carrier's physical address (e.g. 'TX', 'CA', 'IL').

city.title: Physical City
city.description: City of the carrier's physical address (uppercased automatically for USDOT matching).

statusCode.title: USDOT Status
statusCode.description: Filter by active carriers ('A'), inactive ('I'), or all ('ALL').

addedAfterDate.title: Added After Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
addedAfterDate.description: Find newly registered motor carriers added on or after this date (ideal for New Carrier Leads).

minPowerUnits.title: Minimum Fleet Size (Power Units)
minPowerUnits.description: Minimum number of power units (trucks/tractors) operated by the carrier.

hazmatOnly.title: Hazardous Materials (HazMat) Carriers Only
hazmatOnly.description: Filter strictly for carriers authorized to transport hazardous materials.

includeAuthorityAndInsurance.title: Include MC Authority & BIPD Insurance Enrichment
includeAuthorityAndInsurance.description: Cross-reference FMCSA Licensing & Insurance datasets for active operating authority, BIPD limits, and insurer policies.

maxRecords.title: Maximum Carrier Records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of carrier profiles to return (1–200).

outputMode.title: Output Mode
outputMode.description: Choose between detailed carrier dataset records or a compact MCP vetting summary.
